name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.8.0: the host half injects a boot prelude into the served index so opening DSH shows one continuous kit ignition sequence (the native HARNESS loading screen never paints); the composer gains a themed telemetry rail (speed / cache hit / context) with instrument-panel popovers; reasoning effort becomes a discrete slider and a cogitation-depth progress gauge lives inside the composer. v0.7.18 prevents the modal dialog frame from breaking the composer stats/context popovers. v0.7.17 fixes the black embedded Usage/Top-up page on Windows. v0.7.0: Windows 11 verification pass (DPI-aware hairlines, Contrast Themes, reduced-motion splash skip). v0.6.x: changed-file/deliverable cards, Windows Platform view, icon fixes. v0.5.x: startup splash, deep-diving/process icons, composer removeChild fix. v0.4.2 icon restoration. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。
